dedupe_keys.name: liste des abris velo sur le territoire

description: Liste des abris vélo sur le territoire is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence. Pour faciliter l’usage du vélo, La Métropole Mobilité met en place l’abrivélo, un réseau d’abris vélos sécurisés, gratuits, situés à proximité immédiate des gares routières et des pôles d’échanges. Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are velo, Abris, mobilite douce. The portal shows 42 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-12-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
